# Do Phylogenetic analysis

```{r}
read_clean_tree <- function(file_path) {
  library(ape)
  library(stringr)

  tr <- read.nexus(file_path)

  if (inherits(tr, "multiPhylo")) {
    tr <- tr[[1]]
  }

  tr$tip.label <- tr$tip.label |>
    str_trim() |>
    str_to_lower() |>
    gsub("'|\"", "", x = _)

  tr$edge.length[tr$edge.length <= 0] <- 1e-8

  tr
}
```

```{r}
tree <- read_clean_tree("Results/Phylogeny/species_tree_output.tree")
```

```{r}
# --- Root tree ---
tree <- root(tree, outgroup = "Zhuliangomyces_illinitus", resolve.root = TRUE)

# --- Fortify and add support ---
tree_data <- ggtree::fortify(tree)
tree_data$support <- NA
internal_nodes <- which(tree_data$isTip == FALSE)
tree_data$support[internal_nodes] <- as.numeric(tree$node.label)

# --- Base plot ---
p <- ggtree(tree, size = 0.6) %<+% tree_data +
  geom_tree(aes(color = support)) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#000000", mid = "#ff0000", high = "green",
    midpoint = 0.40, na.value = "black"
  ) +

  # Tip labels with space (no clipping)
  geom_tiplab(
    size = 2.5, fontface = "italic",
    align = TRUE, linesize = 0.3, offset = 0.03
  ) +

  # Internal support values
  geom_text2(
    aes(
      subset = !isTip & !is.na(support) & support > 0.6,
      label = round(support, 2)
    ),
    hjust = -0.4, size = 2.5, color = "#317000"
  ) +

  # Layout fixes
  theme_minimal() +
  expand_limits(x = 1.1) + # force extra space on the right
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Times"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 40, 10, 10) # top, right, bottom, left
  ) +
  labs(color = "ASTRAL pp1 Support")

# --- Save (no clipping) ---
ggsave("Amanita_tree_highlighted.png",
  plot = p, width = 12, height = 12,
  units = "in", dpi = 600, limitsize = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ----------------------- HERE WE HAVE TWO POSSIBLE ANALYSES 

# DO NOT Aggregate Trophic Mode

# Normalize ecology text, keep inopinata as separate group
keep <- c("ectomycorrhizal", "lepidella", "inopinata")

df_Ecology_Restricted <- df %>%
  mutate(Ecology = stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_to_lower(Ecology))) %>%   # normalize
  filter(!is.na(Ecology)) %>%
  filter(Ecology %in% keep) %>%
  mutate(Ecology = factor(Ecology, levels = keep))

```

```{r}

# ANOVA test
anova_result <- aov(PC1_mean ~ Ecology, data = df_Ecology_Restricted)
summary(anova_result)

```




```{r}
# Aggregate Trophic Mode

# Normalize ecology text, map inopinata -> lepidella, then keep only the two groups
keep <- c("ectomycorrhizal", "lepidella", "inopinata")

df_Ecology_inop <- df %>%
  mutate(Ecology = stringr::str_trim(stringr::str_to_lower(Ecology))) %>%   # normalize
  filter(!is.na(Ecology)) %>%
  filter(Ecology %in% keep) %>%
  mutate(Ecology = factor(Ecology, levels = keep))
# Plot PC1 by trophic mode WITHOUT combined lepidella + inopinata group

# Define colors for the ecological niches
niche_colors <- c("ectomycorrhizal" = "green", 
                  "lepidella" = "orange",
                  "inopinata" = "purple")

# Boxplot for PC1
ggplot(df_Ecology_inop, aes(x = Ecology, y = PC1_mean, fill = Ecology)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.color = "red", outlier.shape = 8) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = Ecology), width = 0.2, size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +  # Add points for each species
  scale_fill_manual(values = niche_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = niche_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Boxplot of PC1 Scores by Trophic Niche",
    x = "Trophic Niche",
    y = "PC1 Mean Score"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "none",
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )
ggsave("PC1_niche_box_whisker_inop_included.png", width = 8, height = 8, dpi = 300)



```

```{r}

# Check your current data
cat("Group sizes in df_Ecology_Restricted:\n")
print(table(df_Ecology_Restricted$Ecology))

# Check species matching
species_in_both <- intersect(tree$tip.label, df_Ecology_Restricted$species)
cat("\nSpecies in both tree and data:", length(species_in_both), "\n")

# Check final matched data
tree_pruned <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, species_in_both))
tree_pruned$edge.length[tree_pruned$edge.length == 0] <- 1e-8

df_matched <- df_Ecology_Restricted %>%
  filter(species %in% species_in_both) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ecology) & !is.na(PC1_mean)) %>%
  arrange(match(species, tree_pruned$tip.label))

cat("\nFinal group sizes in df_matched:\n")
print(table(df_matched$Ecology))

cat("\nAny NAs in Ecology?", any(is.na(df_matched$Ecology)), "\n")
cat("Any NAs in PC1_mean?", any(is.na(df_matched$PC1_mean)), "\n")
cat("Tree tips:", length(tree_pruned$tip.label), "\n")
cat("Data rows:", nrow(df_matched), "\n")

# Check for groups with too few species
cat("\nGroups with < 2 species:\n")
group_sizes <- table(df_matched$Ecology)
print(group_sizes[group_sizes < 2])

```

```{r}
# Clean tree labels
tree$tip.label <- tree$tip.label %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  str_to_lower() %>%
  gsub("'|\"", "", .)

# Clean data species names too
df_fixed <- df_Ecology_Restricted %>%
  mutate(
    species = species %>%
      str_trim() %>%
      str_to_lower() %>%
      gsub("'|\"", "", .)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ecology), !is.na(PC1_mean))

# Check ecology values
print(table(df_fixed$Ecology, useNA = "ifany"))
print(sort(unique(df_fixed$Ecology)))

# Keep only shared taxa AFTER filtering
species_in_both <- intersect(tree$tip.label, df_fixed$species)

# Prune tree
tree_pruned <- drop.tip(tree, setdiff(tree$tip.label, species_in_both))

# Subset data to pruned tree and force exact order
df_matched <- df_fixed %>%
  filter(species %in% tree_pruned$tip.label) %>%
  distinct(species, .keep_all = TRUE)

df_matched <- df_matched[match(tree_pruned$tip.label, df_matched$species), ]

# Verify exact identity
stopifnot(identical(tree_pruned$tip.label, df_matched$species))

# Optional: deal with zero-length branches
tree_pruned$edge.length[tree_pruned$edge.length <= 0] <- 1e-8

# Make named vectors
x <- as.factor(df_matched$Ecology)
names(x) <- df_matched$species

y <- df_matched$PC1_mean
names(y) <- df_matched$species

# Final checks
print(table(x))
print(sum(is.na(x)))
print(sum(is.na(y)))
print(is.binary(tree_pruned))
print(is.ultrametric(tree_pruned))
print(min(tree_pruned$edge.length))

set.seed(123)
phylanova_result <- phylANOVA(
  tree = tree_pruned,
  x = x,
  y = y,
  nsim = 1000
)

print(phylanova_result)

```
